objective: Improve genuine nonzero LoRA performance on Qwen3-0.6B; report independent SFT and SFT+RAG separately.
final_eligibility: Aligned recipes only. Legacy data runs are retained as diagnostic ablations: a later phrase audit found repeated school-spirit and founding-year facts across different official pages despite distinct sentence hashes. See results/tuning/isolation_review.json.
primary_selection: Task correctness over development20 + validation60 (each question equal weight). Fact and refusal rates are also retained. No candidate selection on test80 or fresh_test60.
screening: Compare checkpoints on development20, then evaluate the best two per training configuration on validation60. Expand promising candidates and repeat candidate generation only from development/validation evidence.
final_evaluation: Lock a nonzero adapter and deployment artifacts before running original test80 and newly frozen fresh_test60. Quantized deployment is tested separately from MLX screening.
limits: The original test80 baseline outputs have already been inspected in the prior experiment; it is a repeated reference benchmark, not a new blind test. Fresh_test60 is not generated by candidate models until final lock. Automated fact matching is a strict proxy and can miss semantically correct paraphrases.
data_change: The initial 1500 samples and prescribed initial mixture remain preserved. Task-aligned tuning is a separately labelled 1200/150/150 experimental mixture, with synthetic reading exercises explicitly fictional and never added to RAG.
